reviewer: claude-opus-5-5 (agent), blind look at every hole in both modes

bro-hof-castle-h17.reason: Detaljerad 3D ovanifrån: a straight black dashed bar lies across the striped fairway at the right edge of the view, east of the road, and nothing like it shows in the photo or in Lätt 3D; in Lätt 3D the open water right of the hole is also covered in a wide field of white speckle noise rather than clean water.
bro-hof-castle-h17.fault: Lätt 3D: the white speckles are the map's sun glitter on the ripples (apps/golf/src/map/map-gl.mjs) in a view across the lake toward the sun; at the hole view's zoom they read as static, and three blind looks have doubted them. Tone the glitter down at hole-view zooms in map-gl.mjs. The dashed bar in Detaljerad 3D from above is no fault: it is the driving range's mat line (the campus's range-mat-line on range-grass-tee, with range balls round it), west of the pond in this south-up view; the photo panel is cropped to the hole and Lätt 3D's hole view stops short of it.

bro-hof-stadium-h14.reason: Detaljerad 3D ovanifrån: the big lake in the lower left is washed out by a large milky-white glare blotch, so a third of the view reads as a pale smear instead of water.
bro-hof-stadium-h14.fault: Detaljerad 3D from above: the lake's mirror of the sky's sun glow (water-shading.mjs; the same with ?waterreflect=0, so not the screen-space reflection) spreads into a broad pale blotch on the sun's side of a high view of Mälaren, and reads as a smear rather than as glint. Fix: narrow or weaken the sky-glow share of the water's reflection when the eye looks steeply down (water-shading.mjs), judged against an aerial photo of a lake toward the sun; it touches every course.

bro-hof-stadium-h18.reason: Detaljerad 3D från tee: the whole left foreground beside the tee is a large flat dark grey-blue slab with a hard edge that does not read as path, water or grass and makes the opening view of the closing hole look unfinished.
bro-hof-stadium-h18.resolution: The flat grey-blue area is the asphalt cart path, 4.5 m from the yellow and blue tee marks the view stands at (the pack's cartpath, asphalt): seen from eye height it fills the left foreground with its hard mapped edge. Lätt 3D and the photo show the same path passing the tee.

bro-hof-stadium-h13.reason: Detaljerad 3D ovanifrån: the left third of the view, west of the lake hole, is a flat featureless light-green field with a few scattered dots of trees, which looks bare and unfinished next to the textured rough and woods elsewhere on the course.
bro-hof-stadium-h13.resolution: The open field beside the hole is the grass and farmland east of Stadium 13, beyond its boundary rough: the 2025 photo shows it as a flat, evenly mown field with a few single trees, and the model draws it from the land cover as open ground with the laser's trees. Nothing mapped is missing there.

bro-hof-stadium-h04.reason: Detaljerad 3D ovanifrån: the lower half of the big lake right of the hole fades to a pale washed-out lilac-grey, which looks muddy against the deep blue at the top of the same lake.
bro-hof-stadium-h04.fault: Detaljerad 3D from above: the same as Stadium 14: the pond's mirror of the sky's sun glow (water-shading.mjs; unchanged with ?waterreflect=0) washes the half of the pond toward the sun to a pale lilac-grey in a steep view. Fix: narrow or weaken the sky-glow share of the water's reflection when the eye looks steeply down (water-shading.mjs).

bro-hof-stadium-h05.reason: Foto med de spårade konturerna: the photo is a thin strip at very small scale, too small to check the green, bunkers and the stream crossing against the two renders.
bro-hof-stadium-h05.resolution: The photo panel shows the whole hole at the sheet's scale. Every ring of this hole was looked at on the 2025 photo at full scale on 25 November (ring-review.json: 182 Stadium rings, 7 redrawn) and again blind by the ring reviewer, and both modes draw those rings from the pack. The creek pool by the bridge was looked at again at full scale on 27 November for the reed decisions.

bro-hof-stadium-h06.reason: Foto med de spårade konturerna: the photo is a thin strip, so I cannot tell whether the water in front of the tee is as wide as both renders draw it or only the narrow stream the outline suggests.
bro-hof-stadium-h06.resolution: The water in front of the tee is two narrow ponds (lm-water-659_64-25 and -27, 461 and 797 m2) and the creek between them. On the 2025 photo at full scale (looked at on 27 November for the reed decisions) both outlines lie on the water's edge; from the tee they read wider by perspective, and the overhead view and Lätt 3D draw them at the outline's width. Every ring of the hole was looked at on 25 November (ring-review.json).

bro-hof-stadium-h12.reason: Foto med de spårade konturerna: the photo is a thin strip at very small scale, too small to check the greenside bunkers and where the stream crosses against the renders.
bro-hof-stadium-h12.resolution: The photo panel shows the whole hole at the sheet's scale. Every ring of this hole was looked at on the 2025 photo at full scale on 25 November (ring-review.json: 182 Stadium rings, 7 redrawn) and again blind by the ring reviewer, and both modes draw those rings from the pack. The creek's two pools by the bridge were looked at again at full scale on 27 November for the reed decisions.

open.canonical-control-pending: No independent horizontal or RH 2000 ground control has been measured at Bro Hof; the frame is the 1 m national terrain and the 0.16 m orthophoto, which agree with each other.
open.canonical-frame: The ground origin is fixed in software and has not been approved against independent control, as at every other ground.
open.release-review: The fourteen-gate release review (phone timings, offline and rollback rehearsal) is not run; by the owner's decision of 27 November 2026 the course is released on this blind visual review of every hole in both modes instead.
open.surface-intake-pending: All 36 holes were traced on the 2025 orthophoto, looked at hole by hole and blind by the ring reviewer; by the owner's decision of 27 November 2026 no person reviews the outlines before release.
